project_name.justification: The article provides an update on the 'Savant Gold Project' and the transaction details are listed under the 'Savant Gold Project Highlights' section.

company_name.justification: The buying company is identified in the first paragraph: 'Prospector Metals Corp. (TSXV: PPP) ... ("Prospector" or the "Company") is pleased to provide an update for both the Devon Nickel and Savant Gold Projects in NW Ontario.'

ceo_buyer.justification: The CEO of the buyer, Prospector Metals Corp., is listed at the end of the press release: 'Dr. Rob Carpenter, Ph.D., P.Geo. President & CEO'.

interest_acquired_percent.justification: Under the Savant Gold Project Highlights, the text states: 'Prospector has agreed to purchase the 100% of the Savant Project from Capella Minerals (the optionee)...'

primary_commodity.justification: The project is consistently referred to as the 'Savant Gold Project'.

verified_article_link.justification: The article is about the Savant project and the source link is provided at the bottom of the text: 'To view the source version of this press release, please visit https://www.newsfilecorp.com/release/204256'.

currency.justification: The cash payment is specified in Canadian dollars: 'Prospector to make a cash payment to Capella of CAD $50,000 on closing;'

cash_payments_raw.justification: The terms of the purchase include: 'Prospector to make a cash payment to Capella of CAD $50,000 on closing;'

share_payments_raw.justification: Not populated because the number of shares and a price per share are available, which takes priority in the data extraction hierarchy.

cash_and_share_payments_combined_raw.justification: Not populated because cash and share components are listed separately.

amount_of_shares_issued.justification: The terms of the purchase include: 'Prospector to issue Capella 1,000,000 common shares (with a standard regulatory hold period of 4 months) upon closing;'

share_warrant_payments_raw.justification: No mention of share warrants in the transaction terms for the Savant project.

option_payments_raw.justification: No mention of option payments in the transaction terms for the Savant project.

issued_share_price.justification: The transaction terms mention the number of shares issued, but not the price. Using the last traded price as a fallback, as seen in the detailed quote: 'Last: 0.21'.

exploration_commitment_meters.justification: There is no mention of an exploration commitment in meters for the Savant project.

exploration_commitment_value_raw.justification: There is no mention of an exploration spending commitment for the Savant project. The VTEM survey mentioned is for the Devon project.

nsr_acquired_percent.justification: As part of the transaction, the seller retains a royalty: 'Capella to retain a 1% Net Smelter Royalty ("NSR") on any potential future production from the property...'

coverage_area_raw.justification: The project size is mentioned in the overview: 'Prospector originally acquired a 70% option on the 229 km2 Savant Project in Ontario from Capella Minerals Ltd in 2021.'

coverage_area_unit.justification: The unit for the project area is specified in the text: '...the 229 km2 Savant Project...'

resource_size.justification: The text provides assay results (e.g., '99.6, 60.0, 20.9... g/t Au') but does not contain a quantified mineral resource estimate with mass or volume units like tonnes or ounces.

buyer_ticker_and_exchange.justification: The buyer's ticker and exchange are identified in the first paragraph of the article: 'Prospector Metals Corp. (TSXV: PPP)'.
